templates.why_chosen: Named in the reference as the three-lettered-mini-pipelines exemplar: (A) compression, (B) single-chunk prefetch, and (C) scattered prefetch each reuse the identical guest-memory-bar and file icons so the reader compares how each restores memory.
templates.what_to_learn: Give each lettered mini-pipeline its own identical anchor icon (the segmented guest-memory bar) so a reader can diff panels purely by which cells fill or how arrows route into it; box the hardware-stage names as real components rather than plain arrow labels, since leaving them as labels, a listed weakness, blurs component from operation.
